func:
const { ip, mac: rawMac, rtt, alive } = msg.payload;

if (!rawMac) 
  return null;

const mac   = rawMac.toLowerCase();

const aliveLit = alive ? 'true' : 'false';
const rttLit   = (rtt !== null && rtt !== undefined) ? rtt : 'NULL';

msg.payload = [`
      INSERT INTO network_device (
        mac_address,
        ip_address,
        comment)
      VALUES (
        '${mac}',
        '${ip}',
        'auto discovered')
      ON CONFLICT (mac_address) DO NOTHING;`.trim(),
      
      `INSERT INTO device_scan_log (
        device_id,
        status,
        rtt_ms,
        mac_address,
        ip_address)
      SELECT
        id,
        ${aliveLit},
        ${rttLit},
        '${mac}',
        '${ip}'
      FROM network_device
      WHERE mac_address = '${mac}';`.trim()
    ];

return msg;
